title: #47 Limit Car
prompt: Should individuals limit the use of cars and use alternatives instead to protect the environment?

promptSegments.text: Should individuals limit the use of cars and use alternatives instead to protect the environment?

requirements.en: State how far you agree or disagree.
requirements.vi: Nêu rõ mức độ đồng ý hoặc không đồng ý.

requirements.en: Support your position with two clear reasons.
requirements.vi: Bảo vệ quan điểm bằng 2 lý do rõ ràng.

requirements.en: Use relevant examples when they strengthen an idea.
requirements.vi: Sử dụng các dẫn chứng thực tế thuyết phục để củng cố luận điểm.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Limiting car use helps keep our air clean.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Limiting car use helps keep our air clean.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: Using alternatives to cars is good for public health.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Using alternatives to cars is good for public health.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Cars are necessary for daily life because many areas are spread out and public transport is not always available.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Cars are necessary for daily life because many areas are spread out and public transport is not always available.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: Limiting car use is not always good for everyone because cars are needed for many daily activities.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Limiting car use is not always good for everyone because cars are needed for many daily activities.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Limiting car use helps to reduce air pollution in cities because fewer cars mean less exhaust gas, which improves air quality and is good for everyone.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Limiting car use helps to reduce air pollution in cities because fewer cars mean less exhaust gas, which improves air quality and is good for everyone.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: Shifting away from cars also saves natural resources, as public transport systems use less fuel per person compared to making and maintaining cars.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Shifting away from cars also saves natural resources, as public transport systems use less fuel per person compared to making and maintaining cars.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Limiting car use is impractical because cars are necessary for daily life and local economies.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Limiting car use is impractical because cars are necessary for daily life and local economies.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: Focusing only on car use is flawed because public transport is often inadequate, making personal vehicles vital for modern society.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Focusing only on car use is flawed because public transport is often inadequate, making personal vehicles vital for modern society.

promptTraps.en: Do not answer only the first question while neglecting the second requirement; address both dimensions equally.
promptTraps.vi: Không chỉ trả lời câu hỏi đầu tiên mà bỏ quên yêu cầu thứ hai; cần giải quyết cả hai khía cạnh công bằng.

promptTraps.en: Do not merely rephrase the topic without stating a definitive personal position in both intro and conclusion.
promptTraps.vi: Không chỉ diễn đạt lại đề bài mà quên khẳng định rõ lập trường cá nhân ở cả mở bài và kết bài.

faq.questionVi: Đề này đang hỏi điều gì?

faq.questionVi: Tôi nên dùng bao nhiêu ý chính?
faq.answerEn: Use two developed points with explanation and relevant examples.
faq.answerVi: Dùng hai luận điểm được phát triển bằng giải thích và ví dụ phù hợp.

faq.questionEn: Can I use a personal example?
faq.questionVi: Tôi có thể dùng ví dụ cá nhân không?
faq.answerEn: Yes, if it directly supports the point and remains relevant to the prompt.
faq.answerVi: Có, nếu ví dụ trực tiếp hỗ trợ luận điểm và vẫn liên quan đến đề.

faq.answerEn: Avoid memorised general sentences and any idea that does not answer the task.
